# Harrison

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged (over sixty)  <sub>[v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v2 c25 P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>
- **Origin:** Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 c24 P7](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** J. A. Harrison  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013)</sub>; James A.  <sub>[v2 c25 P11](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0011), [v2 c25 P13](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat, bald man with prominent blue eyes. Before his reconciliation with his wife, he wore torn and ragged working clothes, but later appeared neatly patched, brushed, and sprucely shaved. He has a habit of smoking a pipe on his veranda.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## Personality

Mr. Harrison is a blunt, crusty, and outspoken man who prides himself on telling the truth regardless of others' feelings, though he possesses a kind heart and a jovial, humorous side. He has a reputation for being an eccentric crank and is known for his quick temper when annoyed, such as when livestock strays into his crops. Despite his gruff exterior and dislike of gossip, he grows fond of young company and appreciates neighborly fellowship. He also enjoys reading and smoking his pipe.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c9 P9](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0009), [v2 c9 P41](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0041)_

## History

Mr. J. A. Harrison bought Robert Bell's farm in Avonlea and moved there from New Brunswick, initially passing himself off as a bachelor after separating from his wife, Emily, due to domestic disagreements and his profane parrot, Ginger. He gained a reputation in Avonlea for being a crusty, outspoken crank who kept an untidy house. After Anne Shirley's Jersey cow strayed into his oatfield, he had an angry confrontation with her, but they soon reconciled when Anne inadvertently sold his own cow to a trader and personally confessed her mistake. Touched by her honesty, he became good friends with Anne and supported her Village Improvement Society projects. Eventually, his wife Emily discovered his whereabouts through a newspaper item and joined him in Avonlea, leading to their reconciliation and the restoration of an orderly household. Tragically, Ginger was later killed during a violent thunderstorm that struck Four Winds and Avonlea, leaving Mr. Harrison saddened by the loss of his pet. Over the following years, he settled into Avonlea community life, attending church, contributing to the minister's salary, and maintaining a warm, neighborly friendship with the household at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c1 P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 c2 P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 c3 P21](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0021), [v2 c3 P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 c3 P40](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0040), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c24 P2](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0002), [v2 c24 P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041), [v2 c24 P44](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0044), [v2 c25 P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012), [v2 c25 P15](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0015), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 c28 P2](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Originally from Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- Previously kept house with his sister until her death  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- Married Emily Scott, but separated due to domestic friction and disagreements over his parrot  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>
- Moved to Avonlea and bought Robert Bell's farm adjoining Green Gables  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>
- Owned a profanely vocal parrot named Ginger given to him by his sailor brother  <sub>[v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c3 P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 c3 P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038)</sub>
